question: The procedure for the nomination of members to the Rajya Sabha in the Constitution of India is borrowed from which of the following countries’ constitutions?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Ireland.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The nomination of members in the Rajya Sabha by the President was borrowed by the constitution of India from** Ireland.**
 
• Indian President nominates** 12 persons** having special knowledge in various fields.
 
• 12 members are nominated by the President from amongst person having special knowledge or practical experience in:
 
 
• Arts.
 
• Litera
